# Recovery Research Institute

> > Science-based resource for addiction recovery, translating research from Harvard Medical School and Massachusetts General Hospital into practical guidance on treatment, prevention, and recovery support.

The Recovery Research Institute provides evidence-based information on substance use disorders, featuring clinical research on medications like buprenorphine and methadone, behavioral therapies including CBT and Community Reinforcement Approach (CRA), and mutual-help programs like Alcoholics Anonymous. The institute bridges academic research with practical resources for individuals, families, and professionals.

## Key Topics

- Substance use disorder treatment
- Medication-assisted treatment (MAT)
- Buprenorphine and methadone
- Relapse prevention strategies
- 12-step programs and Alcoholics Anonymous
- Cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT)
- Community Reinforcement Approach (CRA)
- Opioid use disorder
- Alcohol use disorder
- Dual diagnosis and co-occurring disorders
- Harm reduction approaches
- Recovery community support
- Addiction prevention programs
- Recovery Research Institute and Recovery Bulletin
- Harvard Medical School and Massachusetts General Hospital research

## Evidence-Based Treatment Approaches

- [Cognitive-Behavioral Approaches (CBT)](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/resource/cognitive-behavioral-therapy-approaches): CBT guide for substance use disorder treatment and relapse prevention
- [Community Reinforcement Approach (CRA)](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/resource/community-reinforcement-approach-cra): CRA behavioral intervention guide for substance use treatment
- [Addiction Treatment Insurance Guide](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/resource/navigating-addiction-insurance): Insurance coverage guide for addiction treatment costs and terminology
- [Prevention](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/resource/addiction-prevention): Evidence-based addiction prevention programs and risk factor guide

## Research on Recovery and Treatment Outcomes

- [Does Alcoholics Anonymous Work? Scientific Review From Dr. John Kelly and the RRI](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/media/does-alcoholics-anonymous-work-review-john-kelly): Dr. John Kelly's scientific review of Alcoholics Anonymous effectiveness
- [What is Recovery? 5 Classes of Recovering Individuals](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/research-post/what-is-recovery-5-classes-of-recovering-individuals): Recovery typology study defining 5 classes of substance use recovery
- [Long-Term Treatment Outcomes for Individuals with Opioid Use Disorders](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/research-post/long-term-treatment-outcomes-for-individuals-with-opioid-use-disorders): POATS study on buprenorphine-naloxone and methadone long-term outcomes
- [How Important is Suboxone Medication Adherence?](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/research-post/links-between-emergency-department-visits-inpatient-treatment-buprenorphine-suboxone): Buprenorphine adherence impact on emergency visits and healthcare outcomes
- [Co-occurring disorders lead to worse treatment outcomes](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/research-post/chronic-care-management-improves-treatment-utilization-but-not-outcomes-for-individuals-with-co-occurring-disorders): AHEAD study on chronic care management for dual diagnosis treatment
- [Will Providing Housing for Homeless People With Mental Illness Reduce Daily Substance Use?](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/research-post/will-providing-housing-for-homeless-people-with-mental-illness-reduce-daily-substance-use): Vancouver Housing First study on homeless populations with dual diagnosis
- [Renowned Addiction Specialist, Dr. John F. Kelly of Massachusetts General on Treating Addiction as a Chronic Disease](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/press-releases/renowned-addiction-specialist-dr-john-f-kelly-of-massachusetts-general-on-treating-addiction-as-a-chronic-disease): Dr. John Kelly interview on chronic disease model of addiction treatment

## Recovery Support and Community Resources

- [All About Recovery Community Centers](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/media/all-about-recovery-community-centers): SAMHSA recovery community centers and peer support services overview
- [10 Tips for Staying Sober During the Holidays](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/media/159-2): Holiday sobriety tips for relapse prevention and seasonal support
- [Organization Highlight: Phoenix Multisport](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/organizational-highlights/organization-highlight-phoenix-multisport): Phoenix Multisport profile: active recovery through fitness programming

## Assessment and Screening Tools

- [The AUDIT (Alcohol Use Disorder Identification Test) is Used Worldwide, So How Does It Perform on U.S. College Students?](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/research-post/the-audit-alcohol-use-disorder-identification-test-is-used-worldwide-so-how-does-it-perform-on-u-s-college-students): WHO AUDIT validation study for college student alcohol screening
- [The First Step in Changing Behavior: Understanding the Reasons Behind It](https://www.recoveryanswers.org/research-post/the-first-step-in-changing-behavior-understanding-the-reasons-behind-it): UK study on methadone maintenance, harm reduction, and behavior change
